in_arabic.name: رحمان
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعني رحمة الله تعالى الكثيرة والمستدامة، وهي صفة تعزية للرب الحنيف، وتؤكد على فضل الرحمة في الإسلام، ويرى بعض العلماء أنها صفة تنعكس في شخصية من يسمى بهذا الاسم، وتعكس أيضًا تقدير الإنسان لرحمة الله

in_urdu.name: رحمان
in_urdu.long_meaning: رحمان کا نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی بہت سی رحمت و کرم کی علامت ہے، یہ نام قرآن پاک میں بھی موجود ہے۔ بعض علماء کا کہنا ہے کہ جس شخص کو رحمان کا نام دیا جائے وہ خود بھی رحمت اور کرم کا باعث بنے گا۔

in_hindi.name: रहमान
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह की बहुत सी दया और कृपा
in_hindi.long_meaning: रहमान का नाम अल्लाह की बहुत सी दया और कृपा की علामत है। यह नाम कुरआन में भी मौजूद है। कुछ विद्वानों का कहना है कि जिस व्यक्ति को रहमान का नाम दिया जाए वह अपने आप में भी दया और कृपा का कारण बन जाएगा।

in_pashto.name: رحمان
in_pashto.long_meaning: رحمان د الله تعالى د کړې د رحمت د ډول په معنا سره دی، دا نوم د اسلامي دین په متن کې په ځانګړي ډول په قرآن کريم کې د الله تعالى د رحمت او کرم له نوميږي، دا نوم دا ځانګړی ځای لري چې د الله تعالى د رحمت او کرم له نوميږي

in_english.name: Rahmaan
in_english.meaning: The all-merciful, the most gracious, and the all-beneficent
in_english.long_meaning: Rahmaan is a name that signifies the boundless and eternal mercy and compassion of Allah, as mentioned in the Quran. According to Islamic tradition, a person named Rahmaan is expected to embody the qualities of mercy and compassion, reflecting the values of kindness, generosity, and benevolence. This name is also seen as a blessing, as it reminds one of the infinite mercy and kindness of Allah.

pronunciation.urdu: رَحمَان کا تلفظ اردو میں رحماَن ہے
pronunciation.hindi: रहमान का उच्चारण हिंदी में रहमान है
pronunciation.pashto: رحمان د تلفظ په پښتو کې رحمان دی

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rahmaan" holds deep cultural significance within the Islamic world. It is a constant reminder of Allah's (God) infinite mercy and compassion towards humanity. This name is often used in daily prayers, invocations, and blessings. In various Islamic communities, the name "Rahmaan" is also used in the naming of children, mosques, and other religious institutions. The Name "Rahmaan" is also used in various verses of the Quran, emphasizing the importance of seeking Allah's mercy and compassion in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Rahmaan" is a source of great comfort and solace for Muslims. It is a reminder that no matter what hardships or challenges we face in life, Allah is always there for us, full of mercy and compassion. The name "Rahmaan" also encourages us to be merciful and compassionate towards others, as we are created in the image of Allah, who is the ultimate source of compassion and mercy. In Islamic teachings, it is believed that calling upon Allah with the name "Rahmaan" can bring forgiveness of sins and blessings in one's life. Overall, the name "Rahmaan" is a powerful reminder of Allah's endless compassion and mercy, and a call to be more compassionate and merciful towards others.
